name: LLM API
description: Upload bank or credit-card statements (CSV, OFX, QFX) and an LLM (Claude, or a local model via Ollama) recommends an account for each transaction. Optionally checks Gmail (no IMAP needed) or an IMAP mailbox on a schedule for bills, tracks them until paid and matches them to statement payments. With Claude, transaction and bill details are sent to the Anthropic API.
